item.title: Whiteline KTA518 Toyota Prado 150 Front Lower Control Arm Pair Without KDSS
item.body_html:
Whiteline KTA518 front lower control arm pair, listed by the manufacturer for Toyota LandCruiser Prado 150 models without KDSS.

  • One kit contains two control arms with ball joints and four camber bolts.
  • Offset camber and caster correction. The arms are not on-car adjustable.
  • Suspension specialist installation and front wheel alignment are required.

Not for models with KDSS. Confirm the manufacturer part number, KDSS equipment and vehicle details before ordering. A model and year label alone is not fitment confirmation.
